entry.summary:
Kubernetes — PODs with Imperative Way
What is a Pod? (short intro) A Pod is the smallest deployable object in Kubernetes. It wraps one (usually) container instance of your application and provides a shared networking and storage context for that container. When you want to run a container on Kubernetes, you create a Pod that holds it. What is a Multi-Container Pod? (short intro) A Multi-Container Pod contains two or more containers that must run together and share the same network namespace and storage. These are used for tightly-coupled helper patterns (sidecars) like log collectors, data pullers/pushers, or content generators that the main container consumes.
